creator_program.title: OnlyYou Creator Program
creator_program.subtitle: Publish your own videos, photos, and build your audience in OnlyYou | Club. Learn how to join verified creators.
creator_program.access_denied_desc: To manage a creator profile, upload videos, and publish content, your account must have verified Creator status.
creator_program.benefit_1_desc: Your own profile page with bio, links, banner, tags, and category showcase.
creator_program.benefit_2_desc: Upload video clips, photo galleries, and reach thousands of daily visitors.
creator_program.benefit_3_desc: A private channel on our OnlyYou Discord server with automated fan notifications.
creator_program.benefit_4_desc: Full insight into views, likes, follower growth, and post performance metrics.
creator_program.how_to_join_title: How to Join the Creator Program?
creator_program.how_to_join_desc: For legal compliance and platform safety regarding NSFW content, all creators undergo a simple age verification (18+) with staff in tickets.
creator_program.step_1_desc: Connect to the official OnlyYou | Club Discord server with your account.
creator_program.step_2_desc: In the support channel, select '18+ Age Verification' or 'Creator Hub'.
creator_program.step_3_desc: Provide proof of age in a secure, private ticket accessible only to administration.
creator_program.step_4_desc: Our team assigns the Creator role, sets up your Hub, and unlocks your website Creator Dashboard!
creator_program.already_verified: Already verified on Discord? Log out and log in again to sync your permissions.
creator_program.cta_profile_title: Want to publish your own videos and media?
creator_program.cta_profile_desc: Join the official OnlyYou Creator Program, verify your age on our Discord, and receive full creator dashboard access.
